purpose: Defines all current canonical source classes that later registry ingestion must reconcile without inventing physical equipment or renaming stable IDs.

canonical_identity_policy.quantity_one_asset_id: asset_id equals stable source record ID unless authority explicitly establishes another canonical ID
canonical_identity_policy.quantity_expansion: instance-level identity uses <source_record_id>-I### only when tagging, independent state, telemetry, commissioning, maintenance or lab scoring requires individual instances

operating_mode_policy.SIMULATION: synthetic state/fault injection only; commands remain sandboxed
operating_mode_policy.SHADOW: authorized physical telemetry may be read; writes are prohibited
operating_mode_policy.LIVE: physical command path is deny-by-default and requires explicit asset-level authorization, role checks, confirmation where required and audit logging

source_field_map.label: label
source_field_map.style: digital appearance metadata only; never verified physical manufacturer/model
source_field_map.stateful_ref: training/scenario reference only; does not imply live telemetry

physicalization_policy.equipment_device_life_safety_security_ve: required or deferred pending real installation
physicalization_policy.furniture_decor_signage: optional unless training, commissioning, maintenance or inspection requires instance identity
physicalization_policy.architecture_envelope: registry identity when useful for inspection/training/maintenance; physical tag optional
physicalization_policy.digital_capability: not_applicable unless backed by a physical terminal/device

external_semantics_policy.ifc: IFC entity/GlobalId fields remain null until exported or verified from a real BIM model
external_semantics_policy.bacnet: BACnet device/object fields remain null until an authorized BAS exposes them
external_semantics_policy.other_protocols: Modbus/OPC UA/MQTT/HTTP addresses remain unverified until bound to an authorized real source

step_sequence.step2: deterministic registry ingestion and digital-only vs future-physicalizable classification
step_sequence.step4: future physical tag records without installation claims
step_sequence.later: telemetry, commissioning, as-built verification, training runtime and authorized physical bindings

registry_role_policy.digital_only: Spatial/program identity with no separate future physical tag target.
registry_role_policy.aggregate_physicalizable: Physical assembly/group kept as one registry record until per-instance identity is operationally required.
registry_role_policy.individual_physicalizable: Discrete maintainable/inspectable/controllable candidate; repeated quantities expand deterministically to -I### asset IDs.
registry_role_policy.system_semantic: Building system or riser semantic identity; not itself a fabricated installed device.
registry_role_policy.capability_semantic: Equity Uprise software/program capability identity; physical presence belongs to separately identified terminals/equipment.

step2_classification_policy.floor_glazing_records: digital_only because facade-module inventory is the physical envelope authority

step3a_graph_policy.scope: B1 authority-backed source equipment to semantic service family to dedicated riser, plus declared service-family dependencies
step3a_graph_policy.expanded_source_resolution: all Step 2 asset instances whose identity.source_record_id matches a B1 source_equipment_ref
step3a_graph_policy.lab_use: supports source-to-riser causal tracing, fault-propagation queries and first B1 lab scenario derivation

step3b_graph_policy.scope: F1-L7 modeled service branches and endpoints
step3b_graph_policy.relationship_rule: link only canonical inventory refs that resolve to current asset identities; semantic-only branches remain explicit and do not invent physical assets
step3b_graph_policy.expanded_instance_rule: when branch count equals expanded instance count for one source record, pair deterministically one-to-one; otherwise a branch may serve the full canonical asset group
step3b_graph_policy.modeled_connection_point_rule: service endpoint XY is retained for training traceability only and must not overwrite unverified as-built asset center/bounds
